toggleLegend.paid: one-off purchase, but must be paid again to reactivate once disabled

meta.priorityLegend: 1 = buy first ... 5 = situational/skip. The priority/audience/rationale fields are judgement; each rationale states whether it is wiki-supported or an inference.
meta.affectsTasksNaming: Task names use the RuneLite Task enum display name (task-enum.txt column 2). Rockslugs, Mutated zygomites and Gargoyles are absent from task-enum.txt but present in runelite Task.java (ROCKSLUGS 'Rockslugs', MUTATED_ZYGOMITES 'Mutated zygomites', GARGOYLES 'Gargoyles'); those names are taken from Task.java.

wikiClaims.SlayerRewards_page: 'Purchasing each unlock and extend reward once costs 15,510 points'
wikiClaims.SlayerRewardPoint_page: 'A total of 11,580 points are required in order to obtain all the rewards and blocks at least once ... Excluding the slayer helmet recolours reduces this to 3,580 points'

totals.note: Computed sums of the table rows in this run do not match either wiki sentence; the wiki totals appear stale relative to the tables (which were repriced 27 Aug 2025 and 22 Jul 2026).

unlocks.name: Gargoyle Smasher
unlocks.toggle: permanent (cannot be disabled; one-off purchase)
unlocks.effect: Gargoyles are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has a rock hammer in their inventory.
requirements: Rock hammer in inventory (to trigger the effect)
unlocks.rationale: Inference: removes the manual rock-hammer finish on a common high-level task; wiki states only the mechanic: 'Gargoyles are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has a rock hammer in their inventory.'
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Unlock table row 'Gargoyle Smasher | 120 | Permanent'

unlocks.name: Slug Salter
unlocks.toggle: permanent (cannot be disabled; one-off purchase)
unlocks.effect: Rock slugs are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has a bag of salt in their inventory.
requirements: Bag of salt in inventory (to trigger the effect)
unlocks.rationale: Inference: near-free at 10 points and Rockslug is a Mazchna task ('Require a bag of salt to kill', Slayer_reward_point Mazchna boosting table), so it speeds point-boosting streaks. Cost was 'reduced from 80 to 10 points' (27 Aug 2025 change).
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Unlock table row 'Slug Salter | 10 | Permanent'; Slayer_reward_point.wikitext Mazchna boosting table

unlocks.name: Reptile Freezer
unlocks.toggle: permanent (cannot be disabled; one-off purchase)
unlocks.effect: Desert lizards are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has an ice cooler in their inventory.
requirements: Ice cooler in inventory (to trigger the effect)
unlocks.rationale: Inference: near-free at 10 points; Desert Lizard is a Turael task that 'Needs Ice cooler to kill' (Slayer_reward_point Turael boosting table). Cost 'reduced from 90 to 10 points' (27 Aug 2025 change).
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Unlock table row 'Reptile Freezer | 10 | Permanent'; Slayer_reward_point.wikitext Turael boosting table

unlocks.name: 'Shroom Sprayer
unlocks.toggle: permanent (cannot be disabled; one-off purchase)
unlocks.effect: Mutated zygomites are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has fungicide spray and fungicide in their inventory.
requirements: Fungicide spray and fungicide in inventory (to trigger the effect)

unlocks.name: Malevolent Masquerade
unlocks.toggle: permanent (cannot be disabled; one-off purchase)
unlocks.effect: Learn to assemble a Slayer helmet, which requires level 55 Crafting.
requirements: 55 Crafting to assemble (boosts work)
10 Defence to equip (Slayer_helmet page)
Components: nose peg, facemask, earmuffs, spiny helmet, enchanted gem, black mask (+ reinforced goggles if A Porcine of Interest is complete)
unlocks.rationale: Wiki-supported: the Slayer helmet 'is therefore commonly worn by players on tasks' (Slayer page) and 'making it the best melee helmet option for slayers' (Slayer page).
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Unlock table row 'Malevolent Masquerade | 400 | Permanent'; Slayer.wikitext lines 200 and 1019; Slayer_helmet.wikitext line 25

unlocks.name: Ring Bling
unlocks.toggle: permanent (cannot be disabled; one-off purchase)
unlocks.effect: Learn to craft a Slayer ring, which requires level 75 Crafting.
requirements: 75 Crafting to craft
unlocks.rationale: Inference: a Slayer ring 'provides 8 charges for teleporting to useful Slayer sites' (Buy tab note); crafting them is mainly valuable if you would otherwise spend 75 points per ring. Cost 'reduced from 300 to 150 points' (27 Aug 2025 change).
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Unlock table row 'Ring Bling | 150 | Permanent' and Buy tab 'Slayer ring (8)'

unlocks.name: Broader Fletching

unlocks.name: Like a Boss
unlocks.toggle: one-off purchase, but must be paid again to reactivate once disabled
unlocks.effect: Konar, Duradel, Krystilia, and Nieve will be able to assign various boss monsters as your task.
requirements: Per-boss requirements are checked by the master, e.g. 85 Slayer for Abyssal Sire, 95 Slayer for Alchemical Hydra (Konar only), 91 Cerberus, 87 Kraken, 92 Araxxor, 93 Thermonuclear smoke devil, 75 Grotesque Guardians, quest completions per boss (Boss page table)

Caveat from wiki: 'The only way to "block" a boss is by toggling the ability off ... and the 200 point cost must be paid again to toggle it back on.'

unlocks.toggle: n/a (per action)

The Boss page adds that many 'consider the 30 Slayer point cost to be high' for boss tasks.
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Tasks table 'Cancel task | 30-100'; Slayer.wikitext line 908; Mortimer.wikitext line 21
unlocks.costNote: Per-master 30 is inferred from 'the usual 30' (Mortimer page) plus the 30-100 range; the Slayer Rewards page itself only gives the range.

unlocks.name: Block task
unlocks.toggle: n/a (per action; unblocking is free but does not refund)
unlocks.effect: Skips the player's current assignment without penalties and permanently removes the assignment from that master's list of possible assignments until unblocked.
requirements: Block slots: one per 50 quest points, max 7 total incl. the Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary slot; Mortimer has 2 slots
unlocks.rationale: Wiki-supported: 'When boosting with Turael or Mazchna, the player should seek to block tasks that are slow or tedious' (Slayer_reward_point) and 'Cancelling the removal of monsters allows the monster to be assigned again, but does not refund points'. Each master has its own list: 'Shared block lists only apply to Turael, Aya and Spria, with all other masters having unique block lists.'
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Tasks table 'Block task | 40-120' and 27 Aug 2025 change list; Mortimer.wikitext line 21; Slayer_reward_point.wikitext '==Point boosting=='
unlocks.blockSlots: 'There is a maximum limit of 7 types of assignments that can be blocked on one account - one block slot is given for every 50 quest points the player has. For most slayer masters - with Mortimer being the exception - there are six slots for a total of 300 points needed to use all of them. Additionally, one block slot is available once the player has completed the Elite tier of the Lumbridge & Draynor Diary, which requires a quest cape. In Mortimer's case, there are two block slots available.'

requirements: Task Storage unlock (500 points)
unlocks.rationale: Wiki-supported: free since 8 May 2024 ('Storing tasks with the Task Storage unlock is now free. Previously, it cost 50 Slayer reward points per task stored.'). Note: 'Blocking a task that is currently in Task Storage does not also skip it.'
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Tasks table 'Store task | 0' and note 'storage'

requirements: Task Storage unlock (500 points)
unlocks.rationale: Wiki-supported: 'Players can now unstore their stored task without needing to complete or cancel their current one' (15 May 2024).
unlocks.citation: Extending_slayer_task.wikitext (wiki 'Slayer Rewards' page) Tasks table 'Unstore/Swap task | 0'
